name: CGT Vicksburg Lateral

values.EndLocation: Baxter Wilson Plant and Warren Power Plant interconnections, Warren County

researcher_notes: Not an existing row. P6533 is a system-level Columbia Gulf row with no length, diameter or capacity, so this lateral needs its own row under that PipelineName. The EIA Aug 2026 release (sheet Historical Projects 1996-2024, Excel row 192) lists CGT Vicksburg Lateral as a completed lateral, in service September 2001, 37 miles, 20 inch, 285 MMcf/d, cost 20 million dollars, FERC docket CP01-28. The Federal Register notice of 16 November 2000 (65 FR 69295, docket CP01-28-000) independently describes about 37 miles of 20-inch pipe from the Columbia Gulf mainline in Richland Parish, Louisiana to the Baxter Wilson Plant and the proposed Warren Power Plant in Warren County, Mississippi, up to 285,000 dekatherms per day, estimated cost 20,148,000 dollars. The two are an application notice and a later EIA record, so they count as independent. Cost staged from the notice estimate, not an as-built figure. Length is above the 15.5 mile threshold. Owner spelled without a legal form because no exact match exists in the owner list (nearest fuzzy hit Columbia Gas Transmission LLC is a different entity). Parent not researched. No route found yet, so route is unavailable; needs a route research pass.
